# Tracify

> Tracify is an observability and evaluation platform for AI agents. It helps engineering teams trace agent runs, inspect tool and model calls, monitor cost and quality, evaluate changes, and investigate production failures.

Use the documentation for implementation details and the blog for explanatory guides. Public pages use the canonical origin https://www.tracify.tech. Do not infer that roadmap items or third-party integrations are generally available unless the linked page says so.

## Documentation

- [Documentation overview](https://www.tracify.tech/docs): Start here to install Tracify and send an agent trace.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/typescript): TypeScript installation and instrumentation guidance.
- [Python SDK](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/python): Python installation and instrumentation guidance.
- [OpenAI, Anthropic and LangGraph](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/provider-integrations): Wrap provider clients to record model calls, tokens, latency and errors.
- [What is in a trace](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/trace-anatomy): The fields on every run and span.
- [Feedback and scores](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/feedback-and-scores): Attach end-user feedback and typed scores to traces.
- [Troubleshoot your first trace](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/troubleshooting): Fix missing runs, zero cost and duplicate calls.
- [API reference](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/api): Tracify API concepts and endpoints.
- [Evaluation](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/evaluation): Guidance for evaluating agent behavior and quality.
- [Integrations](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/integrations): Implementation guidance for supported integrations.
- [Self-hosting](https://www.tracify.tech/docs/self-hosting): Self-hosting guidance and constraints.
- [Docs MCP server](https://www.tracify.tech/api/docs/mcp): Read-only Model Context Protocol server exposing Tracify's documentation as structured resources for MCP-compatible agent clients.

## Compare and learn

- [Compare Tracify with other tools](https://www.tracify.tech/compare): Tracify vs Langfuse, LangSmith, Helicone, Arize Phoenix, Braintrust and Datadog.
- [Free AI agent cost estimator](https://www.tracify.tech/tools/ai-cost-estimator): Estimate cost per run, per finished task and per month from traffic and token counts.
- [Best LLM observability tools](https://www.tracify.tech/best-llm-observability-tools): How to choose a tool, and who each option fits.
- [Use cases](https://www.tracify.tech/use-cases/coding): Coding, RAG, voice, browser, multi-agent, MCP, support, research, automation and tool-calling agents.
- [Glossary](https://www.tracify.tech/glossary): Short definitions of agent observability terms, one page per term.
- [Trace OpenAI calls](https://www.tracify.tech/integrations/openai), [Anthropic](https://www.tracify.tech/integrations/anthropic), [LangGraph](https://www.tracify.tech/integrations/langgraph), [OpenTelemetry](https://www.tracify.tech/integrations/opentelemetry): Setup pages per integration.
- [Full text for AI](https://www.tracify.tech/llms-full.txt): Docs, glossary, comparisons and integrations as one plain-text file.
